_ordering_rationale: Ordre PV décroissante. 4 business areas ABB (Electrification, Motion, Process Automation, Robotics & Discrete Automation) + order intake (visibilité).

kpis.signal: Segment #1 (~50% CA), beneficiaire grid + data center + EV charging
kpis.description_fr: Distribution électrique BT/MT, EV charging (Terra/Formula E), grid edge, services bâtiment. ~50% du CA ABB. Tirée par grid investment + data center.
kpis.description_en: LV/MV electrical distribution, EV charging (Terra/Formula E), grid edge, building services. ~50% of ABB revenue. Grid investment + data center driven.

kpis.signal: Variateurs + moteurs industriels, marges Operational EBITA >20%
kpis.description_fr: Variateurs de fréquence (VFD), moteurs industriels, drives. Marge Operational EBITA structurellement >20%. Application industries lourdes.
kpis.description_en: Variable frequency drives, industrial motors, drives. Structurally >20% Operational EBITA margin. Heavy industries applications.

kpis.signal: Système DCS + énergie/marine/mines, +8% FY24 sur cycle capex industriel
kpis.description_fr: DCS (Distributed Control Systems), automation procédés énergie/oil&gas/marine/mines/pulp&paper. Cycle long, beneficiaire capex hydrogène + minéraux critiques.
kpis.description_en: DCS (Distributed Control Systems), process automation for energy/oil&gas/marine/mining/pulp&paper. Long cycle, hydrogen + critical minerals capex beneficiary.

kpis.signal: Recul FY24 (-7.4%), cycle auto chinois + EV slowdown, segment volatile
kpis.description_fr: Robots industriels (manipulateurs), automation discrète (PLC). Exposition forte automobile + EV. Recul FY24 sur baisse capex Chine + EU EV.
kpis.description_en: Industrial robots (manipulators), discrete automation (PLC). Heavy automotive + EV exposure. FY24 decline on China + EU EV capex drop.

kpis.signal: Indicateur avancé CA, book-to-bill ~1.0, visibilité électrification + DCS
kpis.description_fr: Indicateur avancé du CA futur. Book-to-bill ~1.0 FY24. Carnet structurellement renforcé sur électrification (data center, grid) et Process Automation (énergie).
kpis.description_en: Forward revenue leading indicator. ~1.0 book-to-bill FY24. Structurally strong backlog in electrification (data center, grid) and Process Automation (energy).

_notes: ABBNY = ADR US d'ABB Ltd (Swiss listing ABBN.SW). Données 20-F SEC EDGAR FY20-FY23 + annual report ABB 2024. 4 business areas officiels ABB depuis split 2018.
